text: SUNDeltaContract[exp] substitutes for all SUNDelta in exp SUNDeltaContract, contracts the adjoint \(\text{SU}(N)\) indices and resubstitutes SUNDelta. SUNDeltaContract[i, j] is the Kronecker-delta for \text{SU}(N) in the adjoint representation with contraction properties. It wraps the head SUNIndex around its arguments.
